name: Deathly Dream
source: Pathfinder #173: Doorway to the Red Star
description: Sinister runes adorn the doorway, opening a portal to a realm of nightmares if anyone other than Dwandek opens the door.
disable: DC 40 Thievery (master) to seal the rift using materials strongly grounded to the Material Plane, or Dispel Magic (7th‑level, counteract DC 33) to counteract the portal.
reset: The deathly dream trap resets automatically as long as it hasn't been disabled or destroyed. Each time it resets, the tiny pocket plane of nightmare it sends its victim into resets as well, so no two victims will ever share the same deathly dream.

generalAbilities.name: Drawn to Nightmare
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature other than Dwandek opens the door

Effect The triggering creature is drawn into a pocket plane of pure nightmare (DC 38 Will Saving Throw save to resist). Each round at the start of their turn, the creature takes 4d8 Mental Damage damage as they are assaulted by otherworldly visions, and must succeed at a new Will save against the original DC to be ejected from the pocket plane and deposited in the center of area A5.
